info.title: 📚 Booklio API
info.description:
Welcome to the **Booklio API**!  
Booklio empowers buyers, sellers, and book enthusiasts to connect seamlessly in one platform.  

✨ **API Overview**:  
- 📖 **Add/Remove Books**: Easily manage your book inventory as a seller.  
- 🛍️ **Browse Books by Genre**: Discover a wide range of genres to suit your taste.  
- 🤝 **Seller & Stock Management**: Keep track of stock levels and find sellers for specific books.  
- 🔍 **Advanced Book Search**: Filter by genre, ISBN, or seller to find exactly what you need.  

This API is designed for developers building applications that connect buyers and sellers in the Booklio ecosystem. From browsing books to managing sellers, Booklio provides all the endpoints you'll need.  
Let's make the world of books more accessible, one API call at a time! 🚀
